No worker or workbench is required. Uses Base UI Autocomplete, its free-text combobox API, with virtualized supplied suggestions.

items.name: finstack-chart
items.docs: Standalone native SVG publication figure with complete titles, captions, sources and exports. Supply native chart definitions for scale/axis/unit conventions and annotation marks. Import the theme; no WASM, forms, tables or worker runtime is required. Export needs a same-origin font stylesheet and explicit dimensions.
